subject.title: feat #94529: auto-derive session title in sidebar

question: Should maintainers continue this narrow derived-title-only PR as a separate fix, or rely on the newer generated-title/accessibility branches for the session-history direction?
rationale: Current main partially solves new dashboard session titles, this PR still covers a narrower derived-title fallback, and an overlapping accessibility PR exists but is also conflicting; automation should not choose the product scope on its own.

options.title: Port the narrow fix
options.body: Keep this PR's scope limited to requesting and rendering existing derived titles, but require a rebase/port, raw-key guard, and exact-head UI proof before merge.

options.title: Use the broader session-history path
options.body: Treat the accessibility/session-history branch as the canonical direction only after maintainers accept its broader scope and resolve its merge/proof state.

options.title: Close after current-title verification
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers decide generated `displayName` titles on current main cover the needed behavior and historical derived-title fallback is not required.

recommendation.title: Port the narrow fix
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's scope limited to requesting and rendering existing derived titles, but require a rebase/port, raw-key guard, and exact-head UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original session picker capability and has adjacent history in the picker module, making him the best available routing owner for the narrow-versus-broad UI direction.
